provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Ranch

examples.psychological_goal: 用第二人称邀约锁定有田园资产幻想的观众
examples.expression_mechanism: 资产邀约（So you want to own X）
examples.example_text: Okay, so you want to own a ranch.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你想拥有X'开场，X选被电影/照片浪漫化的资产
examples.negative_instruction: X必须是观众有强烈画面的向往之物

examples.psychological_goal: 点破梦幻画面的商业来源，把观众的经验转为怀疑
examples.expression_mechanism: 幻觉归因（movies sell you / photos designed to make you feel）
examples.example_text: That's what movies sell you. That's what the real estate listing photos are designed to make you feel.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习指出美好画面的'设计者'，让观众意识到自己一直在被营销
examples.negative_instruction: 归因必须真实（电影/房源照片），不要泛泛怪罪'媒体'

examples.psychological_goal: 用时间频率对照给出全片的结构病
examples.expression_mechanism: 频率对照（revenue seasonally / expenses daily）
examples.example_text: your revenue arrives once or twice a year, your expenses arrive every single day
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'收入一年一两次，支出每天一次'的不对称节奏概括一门生意
examples.negative_instruction: 频率陈述必须是该生意的真实节律，不可夸张

examples.psychological_goal: 预告一个常见误判，让观众自查
examples.expression_mechanism: 陷阱预告（the trap that gets new buyers）
examples.example_text: here is the trap that gets a lot of new buyers.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'新买家最常掉的坑'引出反直觉分析
examples.negative_instruction: 预告的坑必须紧接着完整拆解（便宜地为何更贵）

examples.psychological_goal: 把'贵=好'的直觉拆成两个独立变量
examples.expression_mechanism: 变量拆分宣判（price and profitability are two different numbers）
examples.example_text: The price of the land and the profitability of the land are two completely different numbers.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X的A与X的B是两个不同的数字'纠正常见混同
examples.negative_instruction: 拆分前必须给出双向证据（便宜地贵运营/贵地便宜运营）

examples.psychological_goal: 用'你以为X，实际Y'打碎产权幻觉
examples.expression_mechanism: 产权重定义（a piece of dirt with the sign removed）
examples.example_text: You think you own a ranch. What you actually own is a very expensive piece of dirt with a for sale sign removed from it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在交割完成的心理高点立刻给出冷峻重定义
examples.negative_instruction: 重定义后必须给出'还差什么'（基础设施层叠）

examples.psychological_goal: 给巨额基础设施投入定性：这不是投资，是入场券
examples.expression_mechanism: 成本定性（the cost of being ready to begin）
examples.example_text: This is money that goes into the property and does not generate any immediate return. It is the cost of simply being ready to begin.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'这是仅仅为了准备好开始的成本'区分准备成本与生产投资
examples.negative_instruction: 定性前必须先完成层叠列举（围栏/水/设施/仓储）

examples.psychological_goal: 用动词排比冷幽默讲透活畜资产的风险
examples.expression_mechanism: 动词排比冷幽默（breathes, eats, gets sick, dies, escapes）
examples.example_text: unlike a warehouse, your inventory breathes, eats, gets sick, dies, escapes, and occasionally refuses to cooperate.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一串递增的动词把'活库存'的风险讲得又好笑又真实
examples.negative_instruction: 排比要按严重程度递增，结尾落在拟人化小幽默上

examples.psychological_goal: 把'全买新'的冲动换算成月供压迫
examples.expression_mechanism: 债务月供换算（debt service runs $X per month）
examples.example_text: The monthly debt service on 200,000 dollars of financed equipment at current interest rates can easily run 3,000 to 4,000 dollars per month.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把一次性采购决策换算成月度偿债数字，制造持续压迫感
examples.negative_instruction: 月供数字需注明融资额与利率语境

examples.psychological_goal: 用六个词给出全行最核心的结构病
examples.expression_mechanism: 六字对仗宣判（seasonally vs daily）
examples.example_text: Revenue arrives seasonally. Expenses arrive daily.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把结构性矛盾压缩成一对时间副词的对仗
examples.negative_instruction: 这种极短对仗必须由前后文的具体例子支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用日常对照物完成 ROI 羞辱并命名为'脏秘密'
examples.expression_mechanism: 日常对照羞辱 + 脏秘密命名
examples.example_text: A savings account at a credit union pays more. This is the dirty secret of commodity cattle ranching
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在给出ROI后，用一个观众熟悉的低门槛对照物落锤
examples.negative_instruction: '脏秘密'类措辞必须紧跟完整演算，否则是耸动

examples.psychological_goal: 用'给予-收回'对仗定义周期的残酷
examples.expression_mechanism: 给予/收回对仗（gives you, takes back）
examples.example_text: What the cattle market gives you in a good year, a drought takes back over the following 3 years.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X给你的，Y会拿回去'总结周期性风险
examples.negative_instruction: 时间跨度（3年）必须与前文周期数据一致

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个物质意象承载代际毁灭的重量
examples.expression_mechanism: 物质意象（reliably fed for decades → cracked clay）
examples.example_text: Pastures that had reliably fed cattle for decades turned to cracked clay.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'可靠了数十年的X变成了Y'的具体意象代替抽象损失
examples.negative_instruction: 意象必须来自案例真实细节，不可虚构

examples.psychological_goal: 给出多元化工具箱的第一个可量化选项
examples.expression_mechanism: 单位费率引用（$X per acre per year）
examples.example_text: Annual per acre hunting lease rates in strong deer country can run anywhere from 5 to 25 dollars per acre.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习给出'每亩每年'的可复算费率，让观众能套自己的数字
examples.negative_instruction: 费率需注明地区条件（强鹿区）

examples.psychological_goal: 用酒店式报价让'卖体验'的收入具象化
examples.expression_mechanism: 体验定价引用（$X per person per night）
examples.example_text: Nightly rates at premium guest ranches run $300 to $800 per person per night, all-inclusive.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把'卖体验'翻译成观众熟悉的每晚房价格式
examples.negative_instruction: 报价需注明全包/高端定位，避免观众按 motel 价理解

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连否定排比解释土地的资产性格
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定排比（does not go to zero / no bad quarter）
examples.example_text: It does not go to zero. It does not suffer a corporate earnings miss. It does not have a bad quarter.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'它不会X、不会Y、不会Z'给一种资产的安全感定性
examples.negative_instruction: 否定项必须与其他资产类别形成真实对照

examples.psychological_goal: 用主语对调揭示富人买牧场的真实逻辑
examples.expression_mechanism: 主配角对调金句（X is not the business. Y is the business.）
examples.example_text: The cattle are not the business. The tax status is the business.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X不是生意，Y才是生意'揭穿表面经营的真实功能
examples.negative_instruction: 对调前必须完成豁免机制的完整解释

examples.psychological_goal: 用'每美元11美分'让经营与地产的悬殊可感
examples.expression_mechanism: 单位换算对照（11 cents of every dollar）
examples.example_text: the cattle operation covers about 11 cents of every dollar of the land financing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把覆盖率换算成最小货币单位，展示悬殊
examples.negative_instruction: 换算必须忠实于前文账本数字

examples.psychological_goal: 用分工金句给出全片最核心的财富机制
examples.expression_mechanism: 分工对偶（X pays the privilege. Y builds the wealth.）
examples.example_text: The cattle pay for the privilege of owning the land. The land builds the wealth.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X负责付账，Y负责造富'的分工句概括双资产结构
examples.negative_instruction: 分工必须与前文的增值/偿债数字吻合（4%≈$140万≈年偿债）

examples.psychological_goal: 用'同时握住两个真相'收束浪漫与现实的双线
examples.expression_mechanism: 双真相收束（hold both truths, plan accordingly）
examples.example_text: The people who thrive here are the ones who hold both of those truths at the same time, and plan accordingly.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾不选边（不否定浪漫也不否定账本），要求观众同时持有
examples.negative_instruction: 两个真相必须都是全片论证过的（浪漫真实/账本复杂）
